message.content:
The largest planet that has been confirmed so far is **HD 100546 b**.  
It orbits the young star HD 100546 and has a radius of roughly **2.5 × Jupiter’s radius** (about 180,000 km). This makes it the biggest planet we’ve found in our galaxy—and, as far as we know, the biggest planet in the entire observable universe.
